title: ReferenceTypesObject
description:
* `external` - Represents a reference to entities or resources that exist outside the current system or organization.
 * `Group` - Refers to a reference type that identifies a collection of users or entities within a system.
 * `User` - Denotes a reference to an individual who interacts with the system.
 * `Machine` - Indicates a reference to a computing device or automated system.
